title: Cisco ThousandEyes security
description: Use ThousandEyes BGP and DNS tests as a security early warning: unexpected origin ASes and route hijacks, BGP update storms, path leaks, DNSSEC failures, and an audit trail of admin changes in ThousandEyes itself.

requiredData.notes: Enable the Tests Stream metrics input and the Event input (activity log) in ta_cisco_thousandeyes. Needs BGP tests (or 'Collect BGP data' on layered tests) and DNSSEC tests.

industrySources.control: BGP monitoring: route hijacks, leaks, unexpected origin ASes, flapping, RPKI validity
Activity log: admin changes to tests, alerts, users, agents

curationNotes: No dedicated RPKI UC; hijack and RPKI coverage maps to AS-path and UPDATE-volume UCs.
UC-5.9.48 lists UC-5.9.18 (Internet Insights) as a prerequisite; relax that prerequisite before publishing.
Skips Internet Insights DNS / proxy issue events (same extra package as UC-5.9.18).
